title: Evaluation at an indicator vector
statement: Let $c$ be a coefficient family indexed by subsets of $\{1,\ldots,n\}$ and let $U\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}$. The algebraic normal form with coefficients $c$, evaluated at the vector equal to $1$ on $U$ and $0$ elsewhere, is $\sum_{S\subseteq U}c(S)$.
